pxa-sat-1.webp.zh: 从卫星图看，阿通邦苏机场（PXA）的跑道嵌在绿色植被与农田之间。
pxa-sat-1.webp.en: On the satellite image, the runway at Atung Bungsu Airport (PXA) sits between green vegetation and farmland.

pxa-chatgpt-01.webp.zh: 晴朗的蓝天下，黄绿相间的航站楼外墙上贴着机场名称，楼前花木葱郁，屋檐投下长长的阴影。
pxa-chatgpt-01.webp.en: Beneath a clear blue sky the airport's name is fixed to the green and yellow terminal facade, with leafy plants in front and a long shadow under the eave.

pxa-chatgpt-02.webp.zh: 无人机视角下，24号跑道入口的白色条纹嵌在深色沥青上，两侧是茂密树林和被雨水浸成褐色的泥土。
pxa-chatgpt-02.webp.en: An aerial view shows the white bars of runway 24's threshold set on dark asphalt, flanked by dense forest and earth stained brown by rain.

pxa-chatgpt-03.webp.zh: 一架白色高翼单发涡桨小飞机停在机坪上，远处绿色的田野与淡蓝色的山峦在薄雾里连成一片。
pxa-chatgpt-03.webp.en: A small white high-wing single-engine turboprop stands on the apron, with green fields and pale blue hills fading together in the haze beyond.

pxa-chatgpt-04.webp.zh: 从高处俯瞰，低矮的航站楼坐落在开阔的绿地中，背后是连绵的青色山脉，左侧有一座带小圆顶的白色建筑。
pxa-chatgpt-04.webp.en: From above, the low terminal sits in open green ground with a long blue mountain range behind it and a small white domed building to the left.

pxa-chatgpt-05.webp.zh: 空旷的停车场里，白线划出的车位整齐排列，路缘涂着黑黄相间的条纹，远处山峦在积云下若隐若现。
pxa-chatgpt-05.webp.en: In an empty car park the white-painted bays line up in neat rows beside kerbs striped black and yellow, with mountains faint under piled clouds.

pxa-chatgpt-06.webp.zh: 日落时分的天空烧成橙红色，航站楼的灯光一盏盏亮起，湿滑的地面映着天边最后一抹余晖。
pxa-chatgpt-06.webp.en: At dusk the sky burns orange and red, the terminal's lights come on, and the damp ground mirrors the last glow along the horizon.

pxa-chatgpt-07.webp.zh: 阴云下，一架白色双发涡桨客机停在红顶平房前的泥地上，机尾涂着红色图案，右侧立着橙色的风向袋。
pxa-chatgpt-07.webp.en: Under heavy cloud a white twin-turboprop airliner stands on muddy ground before a long red-roofed building, its tail painted red and an orange windsock at the right.
